rules.statement: Account-free Sreva remains a complete first-class health experience; account mode may add encrypted continuity and recovery convenience but not stronger core health features.
Predictions, personal insights, interpretation, and reports remain client-side; remote synchronization infrastructure is not a health-intelligence engine.
Sensitive reproductive-health values must not enter ordinary analytics, crash telemetry, debugging logs, or advertising profiles.

Optional synchronization encrypts sensitive health content on an authorized client before transmission; Sreva-operated infrastructure stores ciphertext plus only minimum operational metadata and cannot read the health content.
Email or SMS may recover account identity but must not independently decrypt old health history; vault recovery depends on an authorized trusted-device path or the user-held recovery key.
Partner sharing is completely opt-in, granular, and revocable; there is no automatic spouse or partner access model.
HealthKit and Health Connect access is optional, granular, and explicit; Sreva's vault remains the authoritative application datastore.
